full_page.content:
1937, June
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 193 Cont.
June 13 R. Miller - 24 - brights disease ... Enrolled ... improving
Loraine Gowenlock blind girl who went to St. Louis - 22 - can read a little.
Page 194
June 13 Phyllis Yates - 29 - Asthma seems almost hopeless Mrs. Holberg - 71 - heart -
F.E. Stapish - 71 - threatening sore throat ...... from Bay City
16 Frank H. Russell - 77 - cancer very - his Wife, Delia - 73 - also very sick
Evelyn Sutton - 20 - domestic Mrs. Bridget Hogan - 83 - intestinal troubles ... very sick Mrs. Priscilla Redmond - 33 - of Youngstown, O. - double inward goitre Mary Creedon - 72 - pneumonia broke leg five weeks ago .... V. Sr. M. Dolores Theresa - bad goitre
Page 195 June 19 Rich. Barnett - 15 - operated on in February - terific Mastoid ..... brain exposed after piercing ear-drum .... Enrolled before operation. Thank God and our Bl. Mother - hearing perfect and health perfectly restored .... Enrolled Today ... $5.00
George Husted - 14 - Lutheran - bit by a dog ... was given "shots" - went swiming .... now badly paralized, can hardly talk, Enrol- led To-day.
Olde LeStage - about 60 - dropsey - heart trouble & brights disease/
Wm. Krasnow - 15 - Jewish - very grave heart trouble - Drs. say no hope "all die of this disease"
Donald Autterson - 18 - graduated last year - got a good position - Last November was stricken with very serious complications ..... on his back ever since in Providence Hospital.
